findings.title: Evidence stays current after the page coordinate basis changes
findings.reproduction: Reseal page 1 after changing /Rotate to 90, UserUnit from 1 to 2, or CropBox/effective CropBox x0 to 10 native points. Leave the region revision, evidence locators and artifact bytes unchanged. validate(document, root) accepts all three.
findings.observed_result: All listed invalid candidate documents were accepted by validate(document, root).
findings.consequence: Normalized box coordinates depend on page geometry and units. Old text/PNG/derived-PDF files are accepted as current evidence for a different native/displayed crop. Page hashes are checked only against themselves, and evidence has no pinned page-geometry revision.
findings.required_change: Bind the evidence derivation to a non-circular exact page geometry/physical-page basis and verify it against the pinned PDF when claiming source-grounded validity. Reject stale geometry even when page/document hashes were correctly recomputed. Preserve explicit author region identity across legitimate revisions.
findings.repair_verification: On a clean valid migrated baseline, change CropBox, effective crop, rotation and UserUnit independently, reseal the page/container and retain old evidence. Each must fail with a freshness/source-basis error; fresh evidence for an unchanged actual source basis must pass. Keep all four independent asymmetric pixel/rotation/UserUnit oracles passing.

findings.title: DPI metadata is not checked against crop geometry and image dimensions
findings.reproduction: Change the first evidence render_parameters.dpi from 144 to 72, preserving its 400 by 600 PNG, source geometry, file pins and all other settings; reseal the container. validate(document, root) accepts it.
findings.observed_result: All listed invalid candidate documents were accepted by validate(document, root).
findings.consequence: The documented render settings can describe an impossible render. Width/height are compared only to the PNG header, so the recorded DPI does not substantiate accurate coordinate/pixel evidence.
findings.required_change: Cross-check DPI, normalized crop physical dimensions, UserUnit, rotation and render dimensions with an explicit Poppler rounding convention. Do not authenticate arbitrary settings solely from their presence in the schema.
findings.repair_verification: The retained false_render_dpi input must fail for inconsistent rendering metadata, while actual 72/144-DPI evidence for nonzero origins, fractional UserUnit and all rotations passes with independently calculated pixel dimensions.

findings.title: A verified printed label can cite evidence from another page
findings.reproduction: Set page 1 label to verified value 2 and cite the exact evidence ID for page 2. Reseal the page and document. The referenced evidence exists, so validation accepts the wrong-page association.
findings.observed_result: All listed invalid candidate documents were accepted by validate(document, root).
findings.consequence: The printed-label mapping is not technically bound to its physical page. A downstream locator can appear visually verified using an unrelated page image; ID existence alone is insufficient.
findings.required_change: Require the label evidence to resolve to the same physical page/source and a current geometry/region basis. Verifying the visible glyph remains a reviewer observation, separate from structural association.
findings.repair_verification: Cross-page evidence must be rejected even if the evidence itself is valid. Same-page current evidence must pass. Preserve unknown cover labels and embedded_unverified PageLabels without promoting metadata to visual verification.

findings.title: Exclusion freshness omits the author region and registry basis
findings.reproduction: Start with the passing synthetic exact exclusion. Keep its decision bytes, box and boundary unchanged; change the region kind/uncertainty and reseal it, or change its author key and corresponding registry entry while retaining the UUID. The same exclusion remains valid. Physical-page remapping is also absent from the partition basis (see R05).
findings.observed_result: All listed invalid candidate documents were accepted by validate(document, root).
findings.consequence: partition_hash covers only source SHA and inventory region IDs/page IDs/boxes. It cannot invalidate a decision after author/registry scope revisions. The frozen IG-1A exclusion contract requires an exact current whole-region and inventory basis; this sidecar must not transfer a prior scope decision into a changed basis merely because its rectangles are unchanged.
findings.required_change: Pin an exact, coverage-independent author/registry/page/partition decision basis that avoids circular coverage hashing, or explicitly report the decision freshness as unknown/stale until reconciliation establishes the required IG-1A basis. Keep technical claim validation separate from human authority/decision authentication; do not invent acceptance.
findings.repair_verification: Change region key, classification, uncertainty, registry scope, source and physical-page mapping separately after a valid exclusion. Old decision basis must become stale/unknown or fail and must not be reported as a current approved exclusion. Unchanged exact basis and separately authentic human evidence can retain their limited scope. The current partition-change rejection must continue to pass.

findings.title: Root validation can accept omitted PDF pages and physical identity remapping
findings.reproduction: For the unchanged pinned two-page synthetic PDF, set page_count and both named independent count records to 1, retain only page/region/order entry 1, and remove evidence; reseal. Root validation accepts a one-page inventory. Independently, swap pdf_page numbers 1 and 2 while retaining physical-page author keys, IDs and registry and removing evidence; validation also accepts.
findings.observed_result: All listed invalid candidate documents were accepted by validate(document, root).
findings.consequence: The counter claims are compared to each other, not the byte-pinned source, and physical identity keys are not bound to immutable physical addresses. A missing real page becomes invisible and persisted IDs silently move to another page without any explicit mapping decision. The frozen 44-page delivery is correct, but the validator is insufficient for downstream edited inventories.
findings.required_change: Use an exact independently verified source-structure basis for page count and page addresses. Validate author-key/registry physical-page bindings against that basis and reject silent remapping. Keep changed-PDF SHA registry reuse refusal intact.
findings.repair_verification: With a two-page byte-pinned PDF, consistent forged one-page counters must fail with actual missing-page/source-basis diagnostics. Swapping physical addresses under the same persisted IDs must fail. Reordering the pages array without changing physical addresses and two fresh registry replays must pass.
